TITLE: SoilGrids250m 2.0 - Sand content
DESCRIPTION: Sand content (50/63-2000 micro meter) mass fraction in ‰ at 6 standard depths. Predictions were derived using a digital soil mapping approach based on Quantile Random Forest, drawing on a global compilation of soil profile data and environmental layers. To visualize these layers please use www.soilgrids.org.
SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Sand content for different depth intervals, globally.
AUTHOR: Batjes NH, Ribeiro E, van Oostrum A
CITATION: Batjes NH, Ribeiro E, van Oostrum A (2020) Standardised soil profile data to support global mapping and modelling (WoSIS snapshot 2019)
COMMENT: I also used the mean value for this property. I downloaded the data in 5x5 km grid resolution via Google Earth Engine.
